projects.title: Stockroom Inventory Demo
projects.summary: We built this inventory management demo to show product search, stock adjustments and low-stock monitoring in one clear dashboard.

screenshot.alt: Stockroom Inventory Demo — original interactive demo preview illustration, sample data

story.overview: We built this inventory management demo to show product search, stock adjustments and low-stock monitoring in one clear dashboard. This is our original demonstration using sample data, not a client result.
scope: Add products and adjust quantities in a local workspace.
Low-stock filters and live inventory value calculations.
process: We designed a responsive interface around the main user actions.
We implemented local sample-data interactions and tested the key flows.
delivery: Self-contained browser demo without sign-in or external services.
Clear sample-data labels and no real payments or submissions.
